findings.detail: the artefact declares simulated corners, and the artefact records no `design_content` at all. A deck rendered from a library topology and a deck rendered from a design sized to its spec are indistinguishable in every other field of this file. The producer must republish the upstream `design_content` record; absence of it is not evidence of design content, and an artefact that will not say what circuit it simulated must not certify this step. Declaring `structure_only` is not a penalty — it certifies, in its own disclosed tier.
